subject: RE: Velox Analytics renewal — request for pricing variance & SLA
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@velox.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@velox.ai
Date: 2026-08-14 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal and ask for variance

Neha,

Thanks again for the quick renewal quote. We're running a tight budget cycle for FY27 and after reviewing usage we need to ask for a few non-standard concessions to move forward: a one-time credit equal to one month of committed spend, a 20% first-year discount on list, a term reset to 12 months (we're being re-orged and can't commit beyond a year), and an SLA addendum for 99.9% uptime with a commit to a single-point escalation contact.

I've attached the procurement note and a short summary of our usage for Q2. If Redwood can accommodate these asks we'll sign the SOW and DocuSign the amendment this week. Please let me know who you need to escalate to.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Procurement, Velox Analytics
Attachment: Velox_Renewal_Request_2026.pdf
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal and ask for variance — Velox Analytics (need exec variance)

Team,

Forwarding Velox's ask. Key pieces:
- One-month one-time credit (approx $18k)
- 20% off year-1 list (deal impact ~ $120k ARR)
- Term reset to 12 months (we usually prefer annual auto-renew 24m)
- SLA addendum 99.9% + named escalation contact

Why this matters: Velox is a strategic mid-market customer (productized analytics) and they cite vendor consolidation during a re-org; risk of churn is real. Current renewal ARR is $720k, with expected growth if retained. Procurement is asking for rapid sign-off (this week).

Requesting: Vivek — can you review pricing and SLA authority? David/Marissa — quick take on retention probability and impact to CS/ops if we add the SLA clause. I've attached their usage report.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_report_q2_2026.csv
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and ask for variance — Velox Analytics (need exec variance)

Neha —

Quick read:
- ARR math checks out. If year-1 is discounted 20% that reduces expected revenue in the renewal year materially; one-time credit is a smaller hit but sets a precedent.
- Term reset to 12 months increases churn risk after 12 months; we'd lose the two-year lock-in.
- SLA addendum: ops implication depends on whether they want credit thresholds or faster response targets. 99.9% with defined credits could be a moderate risk.

Scorecard suggestion:
- Approve one-month credit (retention tool)
- Cap discount to 15% not 20% (middle ground)
- Approve SLA language but limit refundable credits to 10% of MRC and require a 60-day cure period; name our SRE contact.
- Term reset: push back — offer 18 months as a compromise.

If Vivek can approve pricing up to 15% + one-month credit, I'd greenlight and hand to Marissa to finalize operational readiness.

-David

David Kim
Director, Sales
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and ask for variance — Velox Analytics (need exec variance)

Adding CS perspective —

Usage notes from attachment: Velox is highly spiky but predictable across daily windows; Q2 tokens were ~22M and growth has flattened. They lean on caching and have 3 engineers flagged for ops.

Operational risk for SLA: we can commit to a named escalation and 24/7 on-call coverage for outages affecting them, but credit exposure needs limits. If we concede 99.9% with the credit cap David suggested, operational hit is manageable. We should also require they keep an active engineering contact and accept an onboarding health check cadence (monthly for quarter 1).

Retention likelihood: High if we give a concrete short window (30 days) to sign. If we stall, probability drops. My recommendation aligns with David: 1-month credit + 15% discount + 18-month term + SLA with capped credits.

-Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Exec variance request — Velox Analytics renewal (summary + attachments)

Vivek —

Summary for approval:
- Account: Velox Analytics (current ARR $720k)
- Customer ask: one-month one-time credit (~$18k), 20% first-year discount, term reset to 12 months, SLA addendum 99.9%
- Our proposed compromise: one-month credit (approve), 15% discount (ask approval), term: 18 months (ask approval), SLA: 99.9% with credit cap at 10% of MRC and 60-day cure (approve/ask approval)
- Commercial impact: estimated reduction to TCV of ~$95k in year-1 under 15% vs list; runway benefit: retain ARR and preserve expansion motion in 2027
- Attachments: Velox_Renewal_Request_2026.pdf, usage_report_q2_2026.csv, redline_sow_velox.docx
- Suggested approval language for exec note: "Approve one-month credit and a one-time 15% concession on year-1 list pricing; accept 18-month term with SLA addendum limited to credits capped at 10% MRC and a 60-day cure period."

They want a quick yes to sign this week. Can you confirm authority to approve the 15% concession and the 18-month term? If yes, I'll send the amended SOW and DocuSign link to Velox.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Exec variance request — Velox Analytics renewal (summary + attachments)

Neha —

Approved with conditions. Executive note below for record and handoff to legal/ops: 

"Approved: one-month one-time credit; up to 15% off year-1 list pricing; term reset to 18 months (no 12-month single-year resets); SLA addendum allowed for 99.9% with credits capped at 10% of MRC and a 60-day cure period. Approval contingent on legal approve redline_sow_velox.docx and inclusion of a non-precedent clause (one-time concession for Velox only)."

Operational asks: Marissa/ops to confirm named SRE escalation and onboarding cadence in the SOW. Legal to include non-precedent language. Finance: record concession in deal notes and adjust revenue recognition.

Neha — please proceed to send the amended SOW and DocuSign link to Velox; copy finance ops inbox. I'll review the final signed contract entry in HubSpot (deal id VEL-2026-092).
